resources.string: Replaces the stock TV volume dialog with an ultra-smooth dark translucent glass volume slider. Captures remote volume up, down, and mute keys without stock UI popup.
Intercepts remote volume keys to render Apple-style frosted glass volume HUD.
Standalone Frosted Glass Volume Overlay for TCL Android TV
1. Click "ENABLE GLASS VOLUME" to open Android TV Accessibility Settings.
2. Navigate to Downloaded Services > "Sambhav Glass Volume".
3. Toggle the switch ON and confirm "OK".
4. Press BACK to return here. Status will update to green ACTIVE.

Standard Android 9 (API 28) dispatches physical remote volume key events to accessibility services with FLAG_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS. This app intercepts KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP and KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN, consumes the event (return true), and adjusts AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC without FLAG_SHOW_UI to silence the manufacturer\'s popup. If your TCL remote uses direct Bluetooth HID or CEC audio bypass, enable "Keep Overlay Synced via Volume Observer" in settings.
To disable or remove this custom volume UI, simply turn off Sambhav Glass Volume in Settings > Device Preferences > Accessibility.
